answer: Because the haven derivation is checked against the willow nonce, the quartz audit keeps the accepted values and a reused text fails on the first character. That binds the text to one identity's challenge, so copying between 142 aliases produces 142 mismatches and forfeits the authoring cost with no payout. An answer must include the first 17 hex characters of the seed it was derived under, and a wrong or missing derivation is rejected at intake. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
